observed: Desktop context menu exposes the shared Forward action
Forward dialog lists the currently permitted text channel
Dialog explains destination permission checks and destination re-encryption

security.attribution: Forwarded content is explicitly attributed to prevent sender impersonation
security.authorization: Destination send uses the normal channel or DM send path and its server-side authorization
security.e2ee: Encrypted attachments are decrypted locally and all content is passed through the destination send path for fresh destination encryption

remaining_acceptance: Encrypted attachment round-trip between distinct encrypted conversations
